reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited text supports the preferred position: § 7.1 bars unidentified minimum-use or similar charges, § 7.3 bars interest on amounts not ultimately due, and § 27.3 allows force-majeure termination 'without penalty' — no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or termination/minimum fee appears.
Correctly defers the § 2.1 take-or-pay minimum purchase commitment to the MINCOMMIT rule rather than double-flagging the same commercial term, consistent with playbook classification instructions.
No actionable deviation is asserted, so no redline or fallback (3-month early-termination cap) language is required; the finding is retained as internal evidence only.
